mobbin:2c5ec636-6d46-416e-b798-ae09d5188.summary: From a Companies list, the user uploads invitees.csv, maps columns, reviews values, previews create-versus-update counts for Companies and People, confirms, and completes an import.
steps: File accepted: column and row counts
Map columns: pickers and sample preview
Review values: raw to mapped groups
steal: A four-step path keeps a dedicated Review values step before Preview.
The preview shows '+ N will be created' and 'N will be updated' with row-level plus icons, so merge versus create is clear before commit.
One CSV can feed both Companies and People tabs.
The upload step shows columns found and rows found before mapping.
avoid: Mapping Last Name to Domains in the demo path creates avoidable type errors; keep mapping defaults conservative for Essentials field types.
mobbin:2c5ec636-6d46-416e-b798-ae09d5188.fit: Scheduling: strong template for Excel master-file to events: column map, value review, create/update preview, then bulk write. Extend with a session matching key such as room plus datetime or an external ID.

mobbin:535a7828-5915-47a2-b782-c6bfd708a.summary: On Review values, the user fixes Invalid domain errors and missing Categories on the spot (edit, add value, map to existing, or create many select options) before Preview.
steps: Edit domain value on the spot
steal: Orange dots mark columns that still need review, so triage does not need a downloadable error report.
'Needs review N' groups unique values with row counts.
Fixes happen on the spot: type a valid value, add a domain or value, or pick an existing option; skip or ignore per value.
'+ Create N missing select options' creates many enum values at once.
mobbin:535a7828-5915-47a2-b782-c6bfd708a.fit: Scheduling: best pattern for sim-center Excel imports where rooms, groups or scenarios as select fields often introduce new option values. Resolve on the spot before creating sessions.
